senses.gloss: (b. h. √בע, v. בָּעָה ; interch. with בָּהַת q. v.) to startle. [Not used in Kal.]

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 18">Num. R. s. 18</cite>; Tanḥ. Korah 6 <he>נזדעזע אהרן ונ׳</he> Aaron trembled and was alarmed. Y. Shek. I, beg. Bab. ed. <he>נִבָּעֵית</he>, v. <cite ref="B00196"><he>בָּהַת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:1">Yoma V, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Yoma 52b:9">52ᵇ</cite>) <he>שלא להַבְעִית וכ׳</he> in order not to alarm the people (by a long delay). Ib. 39ᵇ <he>למה אתה מבעית עצמך</he> why wilt thou be the alarmer thyself (predicting thine own destruction; Ms. M. a.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 578:10">Yalk. Zech. 578</cite> <he>את עצמך</he>, incorr.; Ms. Oxf. <he>בעצמך</he>; Y. ib. VI, 43ᶜ bot. <he>מבהלינו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

senses.gloss: to be agitated, excited. Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ top שהוא מִתְבָּעֵת for he is excited.
